title: Bisect
intro: Find the commit that broke something. Haunt checks out commits between a good and a bad one; mark each until the first bad commit is found.
badHelp: Where it is broken: a branch, tag or commit. HEAD is where you are.
badHelpOn: Where it is broken: a branch, tag or commit. HEAD is where you are ({branch}).
goodHelp: Where it still worked, such as the last release tag. Or right-click a commit: “Bisect: this one is good”.
functionFirstHelp: Tests the commits that touched the picked function before git's own picks.
pickFunction: Pick a function in the panel to suggest the commits that touched it.
seeIt: See it in the commit list
stopHelp: Back to the branch it started from
tryIt: Run or try it as it is checked out now, then say how it behaves.
noneTouched: None of the commits still in play touched it.
summary: {good} marked good, {skipped} skipped. Stop takes you back to the branch it started from.
